The short version

From SEO intern to strategist, one system at a time.

I’m an SEO strategist at RankMeTop, working remotely from Kathmandu, and I also take on independent consulting. Over 3+ years I have worked across 150+ projects, 100+ niches, 10+ live sites, and clients in six countries.

My work sits where strategy meets implementation: entity-based SEO and topical authority, technical audits, on-page and off-page execution, content systems, reporting, and AI search optimization. When a tool I need does not exist, I build it.

I look for relationships—between entities, pages, queries, systems, and business outcomes—rather than working through isolated checklist items. That habit comes straight from how I was trained.

Computer science, applied to search

A BCA foundation changes how I read a search problem.

My Bachelor of Computer Application from Ratna Rajya Campus, Tribhuvan University, trained me in programming, data structures, and algorithms. I apply that to how search engines process language, entities, and relationships.

What I study

How search systems understand meaning.

I use ideas from NLP, knowledge graphs, query processing, and AI-assisted search to understand how engines interpret entities, relationships, and intent.

Entity–Attribute–ValueStructure pages around extractable relationships, not loose prose.
TF-IDF & n-gram expansionFind the terms and phrases a complete answer on the topic should cover.
Query Deserves a PageDecide whether a URL should exist before writing content.
Answer Span OptimizationWrite the contiguous answer most likely to be surfaced.
Something I built

Content Semantic Flow Checker

An open-source Python app that checks whether content flows logically. It embeds each sentence, paragraph, and section (H1, H2, H3) with a sentence-transformers model and measures cosine similarity between neighbours, flagging abrupt topic jumps against tuned thresholds.

PythonStreamlitspaCysentence-transformersCosine similarity

How I work

Evidence first, then systems, then clear reporting.

How I operate

  • I start with evidence

    Search Console, GA4, crawl data, analytics, and business context come before any recommendation to rewrite, migrate, or launch a campaign.

  • I make the work repeatable

    Useful insights become templates, rules, dashboards, scripts, and workflows that teams can actually use.

  • I report with context

    What changed, why it changed, what I did, and what I expect to happen next.

  • I work across teams

    Comfortable with developers, writers, designers, and stakeholders across time zones, with transparent, async communication.
